verdict.rationale: Better Auth has a dedicated, vendor-maintained Auth0 migration guide covering email/password with proper hashing, social accounts, and 2FA migration, which supports moving users without forcing resets. However, this is the only competitor covered (no guides for Clerk, Okta, Cognito, Firebase, etc.), and there's no dedicated migration CLI tool or automated password-hash-preserving tooling beyond the manual guide steps. missing for 10: migration guides/tooling for other major competing providers beyond Auth0, dedicated automated migration CLI/tooling (not just a manual guide), independent/community confirmation that the Auth0 migration path works without password resets in practice.
